scope: All 112 matching case IDs at both temperatures were read side by side (224 outputs).
rubric: Answer actual message in its conversation context.
Preserve player consent and current selected route.
Avoid invented facts and unsupported safety assertions.
Keep uncertain emotion subordinate to explicit words.
Maintain clear character speech without forcing banter.

recommendation.strength: weak qualitative preference for grounded, repeatable demo behavior
recommendation.reason: Greedy avoids the most elaborate sampled inventions in this probe, with most practical answers equivalent. It is not uniformly better and does not fix route-history or identity-safety failures.

findings.reason: Temperature .5 invents the lantern blowing out again, slippery stairs and exposed stone. Temperature 0 avoids those specifics, although its risk reply still has an unsupported Nothing is broken claim.
